## LankaServe v3.0.1

This patch release removes the demo data from the admin, finance and mobile screens so they show only live records, fixes document attachment linking for uploads made from the browser, and adds automated test suites for the backend, AI agents, web portal and mobile app.

### Fixes

- **Live data only** - the admin dashboard, department admin dashboard, finance dashboard and finance ledger no longer show hardcoded sample figures and activity. Statistics and recent activity now come from the API (officers, departments and audit logs).
- **Mobile completed services** - the "Completed Services & Bookings" screen no longer adds demo applications. It shows an empty state until an application is approved.
- **Document attachment linking** - browsers send attachment names like `C:\fakepath\name.pdf`. The backend now strips both `\` and `/` separators, so the uploaded document is linked to its application when the API runs on Linux.
- **Agent 4 officer briefing** - when the LLM returns no usable briefing (no answer, invalid JSON or an empty field), the deterministic briefing is used instead of leaving it blank. Sanitized form fields are now returned on both approved and rejected results.

### Testing

- New `test/` folder with suites for every part of the system:
  - `test/Backend.Tests` - controllers, duplicate checks, the authorization matrix, verification service and validation rules.
  - `test/AgenticAi.Tests` - agents, catalog, duplicate-check and schema-validator tools, and Agent 4 guardrails, using fakes for the database, vector store and LLM.
  - `test/web` - API and session handling, catalog and departments, ledger and validation (Vitest, run with `npm test` in `web/`).
  - `mobile/test` - models, storage, validators and widgets.
- CI now runs the agent test suite, and the test packages were moved out of the main `AgenticAi` project.

### Documentation

- API reference, architecture and workflow diagrams, and ADRs 0008 and 0015 updated.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/Goverment-Service/Government_Service_Navigator/compare/v3.0.0...v3.0.1
